description: This file defines a React component for rendering and managing admin console schema settings in Mattermost, including various setting types, rendering logic, state management, and configuration handling.

classes.name: SchemaAdminSettings
classes.description: React component for rendering and managing admin console schema settings, including various setting types, state management, and configuration updates.

methods.name: renderLabel
methods.description: Renders the label for a setting, using either a string or a formatted message.

methods.name: renderSettingHelpText
methods.description: Renders help text for a setting, considering disabled state and markdown formatting.

methods.name: isSetByEnv
methods.description: Checks if a configuration path is set in the environment configuration.

methods.name: renderDropdownOptionHelpText
methods.description: Renders help text for a dropdown option, supporting markdown.

methods.name: setConfigValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the configuration object at a specified dot-separated path.

methods.name: getSettingValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a setting from the current state, considering dynamic values and disabled state.

methods.name: getConfigFromState
methods.description: Generates a configuration object from the current state, applying onSave hooks and handling nested settings.
